description: Gnarled, enlarged veins, most commonly in the legs and feet.
causes: Weak or damaged vein walls and valves.
symptoms: Veins that are dark purple or blue
Veins that appear twisted and bulging
An achy or heavy feeling in the legs
prevention: Exercise, maintain a healthy weight, and avoid standing or sitting for long periods.
treatment_action: Compression stockings, exercise, or medical procedures (sclerotherapy, laser treatment).
